newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-RESULTS OF FRENCH CHAMPIONSHIP SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-RESULTS OF FRENCH CHAMPIONSHIP SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Results of French rugby union championship semifinals played on Saturday:
Bourgoin - Tries: Nigel Geany, Alexandre Peclier. Penalties: Geany (3). Conversion: Geany.
Montferrand - Try: Stephane Castaignede. Penalties: Gerald Merceron (4)
Toulouse - Try: Nicolas Martin. Penalties: Christophe Deylaud (5). Drop goal: Deylaud.
Agen - Try: Jean-Charles Cistacq. Penalties: Guillaume Bouic, Stephane Prosper (2). Conversion: Prosper.
Final in Paris on May 31: Bourgoin v Toulouse.
